title: Pod Salt Core Spearmint 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pod Salt Core Spearmint offers a fresh, subtly sweet Mint flavour with a smooth and cooling finish. Milder than Menthol, this Spearmint blend delivers a clean, refreshing vape with just enough sweetness to round off the edge, making it an ideal choice for vapers who prefer a lighter mint profile. Formulated with nicotine salts for rapid absorption and a more comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is suited to MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as pod kits and vape pens. The 50VG/50PG ratio supports discreet vapour production and clear, reliable flavour delivery throughout the day. Available in 5mg, 11mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Pod Salt Core Nic Salts are produced in the UK and designed for vapers seeking consistency, quality and great-tasting flavours that are familiar yet wildly creative.
